title: Homotopy Self-Equivalences of Manifolds
summary: Hambleton and Kreck described the group of based homotopy self-equivalences of a closed oriented $4$-manifold by a commutative braid of exact sequences built from bordism groups and the Postnikov $2$-type. We construct the analogous braid for closed oriented $BO\langle n+1\rangle$-manifolds $M$ of dimension $2n$ or $2n-1$ whose fundamental group is finite or infinite cyclic and which satisfy one condition on the action of $π_1$ on the homotopy of the fibre of $M\to P_n(M)$.
